title: Mustafa Y NDE 8065
content: The experience happened in 1999 or 2000. I felt a severe impact on my right ribs, as I was hit from behind. First, I felt a severe pain but it only lasted for a short moment, maybe one second. I entered a tunnel that was almost completely dark. I was travelling upward with a great speed when I came to a sudden stop. I found myself in a dark place. There was a middle-aged man there with white dress on who was standing some distance from me. His light was the only brightness in that dark space. He came towards me. When he got close, I felt he had a letter in his hand from which he was reading. When he finished the letter, he returned to me. I was back in the tunnel again. Then I saw my body that was lying on the ground and there were people around me. My viewpoint was from the room ceiling as I saw my body and the people who were around me. I could see them from behind. After a few moments, I entered my body and opened my eyes. I now could see the face of the same people I had seen from behind. This scared me that my viewpoint shifted from the ceiling to the floor in one moment. I got up, opened the door, and went outside. My pain was gone.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He reported traveling upward with great speed, coming to a sudden stop, then being back in the tunnel again.

arrival.other_being_detail: A middle-aged man in a white dress whose light was the only brightness in the dark space; he approached and appeared to read from a letter in his hand.

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark place/space with the only brightness coming from the light of a middle-aged man in a white dress.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: He reports being hit from behind with a severe impact to the right ribs.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with a middle-aged man in a white dress who appeared to read from a letter; sudden stop in the tunnel and a dark space illuminated only by the man's light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel/stop in dark space with a being, then back in tunnel, then OBE viewing body from ceiling, then re-entry into body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: He reported being in the tunnel, then leaving it to a dark space, then being back in the tunnel again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A middle-aged man in a white dress whose light was the only brightness in a dark space appeared to read from a letter before the experiencer returned to the tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I entered a tunnel that was almost completely dark. I was travelling upward with a great speed when I came to a sudden stop.”
